announcements.title: What's new in StegZ 1.2
announcements.message:
• New file-manager design: browse every drive and folder
• Opens ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZ, ISO and more
• WinRAR-style right-click menu: Extract here, Extract to folder, Quick zip
• Password toggle with AES-256
• Smarter self-destruct: date, open limit, or timer after first open
• Built-in Help guide: press F1

announcements.title: StegZ for Android is here
announcements.message: Hide files inside pictures, lock them with a password, or make them self-destruct - now on your phone. Files work on both Android and Windows.
